name: Ann
letter:
Hello Ann, this is Kuya John.

I wanted to write you something special today, because it's your birthday.

We met in Claver. I honestly can't remember which event it was, and I'm sorry about that, hahaha. But I remember very clearly how I got to know you: in the elevator. You looked so scared when you stepped on it, and it was such a funny moment. I couldn't help laughing, and I still smile when I think about it. It's funny how a small moment like that can be the start of knowing someone.

Since then, I've been glad to know you. You are kind, you are easy to be around, and you have a way of making people feel comfortable. Not everyone has that, and it matters more than you might think.

On your birthday, I hope you get everything you've been quietly hoping for. I hope you're surrounded by people who care about you, that you laugh a lot today, and that you eat something delicious. I hope this new year of your life brings you good health, peace of mind, and plenty of reasons to smile.

Whenever things feel heavy, remember that you have more people rooting for you than you realize, and I'm one of them. Keep believing in yourself and take care of yourself, always.

Happy birthday, Ann. Enjoy your day, you deserve it. And please, don't be scared of elevators anymore. Hahaha.
